goal: Defeat Erika for the Rainbow Badge

subgoals.goal_text: Sell or discard an item to make room in the bag, as it is currently full.
Travel from Cerulean City to Celadon City.
Purchase items or tools necessary for the gym, or navigate to a floor with useful items if available. Since we have Magikarp and no fire type, we need a way to beat grass types.
Battle and defeat Erika to earn the Rainbow Badge.
